Based on the net sales figures provided [DOC-1], Amazon's revenue growth rates can be calculated as follows:

- FY2023 YoY growth: ($574,785M − $513,983M) / $513,983M = $60,802M / $513,983M ≈ 11.83% [DOC-1]
- FY2024 YoY growth: ($637,959M − $574,785M) / $574,785M = $63,174M / $574,785M ≈ 10.99% [DOC-1]

These figures come from the same consolidated statements of operations within a single 10-K filing, so the periods and accounting basis are directly comparable — no divestiture, spinoff, or segment redefinition affects this comparison.

The growth rate declined slightly, from approximately 11.83% in FY2023 to approximately 10.99% in FY2024, a deceleration of roughly 0.8 percentage points. This is a modest deceleration rather than a dramatic shift, so it could also be characterized as "roughly flat with a slight deceleration."

ANSWER: Decelerated slightly (from ~11.8% YoY growth in FY2023 to ~11.0% YoY growth in FY2024)
